## Playtest
<!--
One line, required. The "playtest-gate" check reads it and branch protection blocks the merge until it passes.
  Playtest: done — <device, how long, what you saw>   only a person who played this branch writes "done"
  Playtest: n/a — <why>                               only when no game file changed (docs, CI, tests)
  Playtest: needs-playtest                            blocks the merge until someone plays it
Agents write needs-playtest (or n/a). Never done.
How to play a PR branch: AGENTS.md, "Playtesting a PR".
-->
